content.text:
I fixed the bug in `src/Tokenizer.ts`, in `outputLink`. I could not run the test suite because the folder has no `node_modules`, so the fix is verified by reading the code only.

**Cause:** `outputLink` sets `lexer.state.inLink = true` while it tokenizes a link's text, then sets it to `false` on exit. An image nested in a link runs through the same function, so when the image finished it cleared the flag even though the outer link was still open. The GFM URL tokenizer is gated on `!inLink`, so it ran on ` www.example.com`, emitted a link, and set `linkEmitted`. The outer link then saw a nested link and bailed, which produced the nested output in the report.

**Fix:** `outputLink` now saves the `inLink` value it was entered with and restores that value on exit, instead of forcing `false`. The text after the image stays plain inside the outer link, and the nested-link check still works for real inner links.

The HTTPS, email and reference-style cases in the report go through the same `outputLink` and URL-tokenizer path, so they should be fixed by the same change. I did not check them by running the code.
